annotation.interpretation_a: A client is permitted to reject the entire RRSet if any RR indicates "no-default-alpn".

annotation.justification: The phrase "if all of the compatible RRs indicate..." is ambiguous. Does 'compatible' refer to all RRs in the RRSet, or only a subset? This affects whether a single RR with "no-default-alpn" triggers rejection, or all must have it.
